{{Quote|Where were the transmissions headed?''"<br />"''Toward Eislomi sector. Specifically, in the direction of the Eislomi III HoloNet relay station.''"<br />"''In other words, a dead end.''"<br />"''Looks like it.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Moranda Savich]]|<ref name="VoF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Eislomi III''', also known as '''Eislo''', was an astronomical object located in the [[Eislomi sector/Legends|Eislomi sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was the site of a [[Eislomi III HoloNet relay station|HoloNet relay station]].

On Eislomi III, [[ratter thist]]s were used to guard livestock in mountain valleys. Many products were exported from the astronomical object, including [[cordioline trehansicol]], one of the only insecticides that could exterminate [[metalmite]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sorry, folks. Did you want us to order some of those krisses for you, ma'am? Klif, you find anything on the lists?''"<br />"''Looks like we can get them from a supplier on Eislo&mdash;have them here in two or three days. Or we can get them shipped in straight from Kordu itself. That'll probably be a little cheaper, but it'll take longer.|[[Drend Navett]] and [[Klif]]|<ref name="VoF" />}}
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[June]] [[2015]] that Eislomi III and Eislo were the same astronomical object.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
